name: Brewmeister Bilger
summary: In Southshore's inn cellar, Brewmeister Bilger waits for deliveries from distant lands. The intoxicated dwarf spends his hours tasting potent spirits.

sections.title: Life in the Cellar
sections.body: Beneath Southshore's inn, Brewmeister Bilger paces the cellar with hiccups. He seeks the strongest brews Azeroth can offer.

sections.title: A Taste for Potent Imports
sections.body: Even in a stupor, Brewmeister Bilger can judge spirits. He favors heavy dwarven moonshines and potent southern liquors. Special batches delight him, such as the moonshine Foggy MacKreel sends from the Thandol Span.

faq.q: Where can I find Brewmeister Bilger?
faq.answer: Find Brewmeister Bilger in the cellar beneath the inn at Southshore, the Alliance port town in Hillsbrad Foothills.
Brewmeister Bilger receives rare liquor from the Wetlands, including strong spirits such as MacKreel's Moonshine, shipped north to Southshore.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can see Bilger's love of strong drink thriving in a human port town far from Ironforge.
As an Alliance member, you can find Bilger in Southshore's inn cellar. He is one of the dwarves who make their home among the humans of this beleaguered town.
